description: Regional component prices for aquaponics cost estimation (aqua_model/costing.py). Every item carries value/low/high in the region's currency, a source, and a basis tag: official = government/utility/manufacturer list price; retail_snapshot = e-commerce or store listing at as_of date; guide = extension/cost-guide aggregate; derived = unit conversion or interpolation performed by us and flagged. These are researched estimates to be replaced by local quotes — never quotes themselves. Missing items are deliberately absent: the estimator shows them as UNPRICED rather than inventing a number.
fx_note: As of 2026-08: 1 USD ~= 31.9 TWD; 1 USD ~= 562 XOF (XOF pegged to EUR at 655.957).

tank_1000l.source: Ouagadougou: used food-grade IBC 96,875 XOF (ouagadougou.online, page read) to 150,000 (FB vendor); new Polytank-type 1000 L 181,250 XOF (vendor price table parsed)

pump_small.source: Côte d'Ivoire proxy (Jumia CI, read): 20 W 7,700-7,800; 35 W high-flow 17,900; 45 W 9,030 XOF — expect a Ouagadougou import markup; no BF shelf price found

air_pump.source: Hobby-class w/ 2 stones 3,500-9,000 XOF (Jumia CI, read); pond-class blower/compressor 33,000-50,000 XOF (Nigeria proxy, snippets) — pick by system size

pvc_pipe_m.source: CI/Senegal per-bar prices interpolated (Maison BCS Abidjan read: PVC32 2,000/bar, PVC50 4,500/bar; Senegal guide read); BF small-diameter bars not publicly priced. BF fittings verified: coude 32 = 150, coude 50 = 275 XOF (songnabadistribution.com, read)

gravel_m3.source: Bobo-Dioulasso truckload prices 2021 (~5,000-8,500 XOF/m3, L'Express du Faso, read) inflated to 2026 (our extrapolation); Abidjan ~14,000-15,000 XOF/m3 at 1.5-1.6 t/m3

raft_foam_m2.source: Abidjan EPS sheets (produitbat.ci, snippet-only): 20 mm ~6,500, 40 mm ~10,425 XOF/m2; CYPE CI generator ~5,800 installed. No BF listing found — phone-check before contracting

greenhouse_poly_m2.unit: per m2 floor, TURNKEY incl. structure+film+install
greenhouse_poly_m2.source: Agro Serre Innovation CI (read): 250 m2 = 14,000 XOF/m2, 500-1,000 m2 = 12,000; Senegal semi-tunnel ~7,000-10,000. No Burkina-specific quote found

shade_net_m2.source: Abidjan (constructeurdeserre.com, Dec 2025, read): 40% = 900, 50% = 1,000, 70% = 1,300 XOF/m2; Senegal roll ~430. Support STRUCTURE unpriced by any verifiable source — budget posts + wire + labour on top

fingerling_tilapia.source: Bagré, Burkina: 60-250 XOF by size (Sidwaya, 28 May 2023, article read); ~100 XOF for 10 g commonly quoted

fingerling_clarias.source: ENESA hatchery sales, 80-100 XOF (Ministry MAERAH FB, snippet); Benin CoinAfrique corroborates 60-100 by size

feed_kg.source: Local Faso Guulgo plant 500-550 XOF/kg (africavet, snippet); imported Ghanaian ~850-1,200 (Sidwaya, read); 2026 ad 640-800 XOF/kg by volume. CP% rarely stated — verify

electricity_kwh.source: SONABEL grid (plateformewattia.com mirror, read; sonabel.bf unreachable): B1 monophasé 96/102/109 XOF by tranche; social tariff to 138; GlobalPetrolPrices avg 123 XOF (read)

water_m3.source: ONEA 2021 tariff PDF (read): households 188 (0-8 m3) to 1,104 XOF/m3 (>25 m3); sociétés flat 1,104; eau brute (raw water) 439 — the realistic farm rate where available. Tranche 1 harmonised at 188 nationwide Apr 2026 (minute.bf, read)

labour_day.source: Tradesmen-reported manoeuvre rate 2,000-2,500 XOF/day (anecdotal, FB); Senegal benchmark 1,500-3,000 (read); SMIG 45,000 XOF/month (Nov 2023 decree). Mason 5,000-7,500/day is a neighbour-anchored estimate

fish_tilapia.source: FAO FishStat implied ex-farm price, Burkina Faso Nile tilapia, official series: 2,000 XOF/kg (2020-21) rising to 2,250 (2022-23) — values back-convert to exact round XOF, so Burkina reports first-sale prices in XOF/kg. Independently corroborated by the government's Mar 2026 administered price (prix de cession) of 2,000 XOF/kg for 400-650 g cage fish; peri-urban tank farms quote 2,500-3,000

fish_clarias.source: FAO FishStat official series, Burkina Faso North African catfish: 1,250-1,300 XOF/kg (2016-2023). Field quotes in Mar 2026 reach 2,000 (hence the high). NOTE THE INVERSION: catfish fetches LESS per kg than tilapia here, in both the official series and field quotes — the opposite of the usual assumption; verify locally before planning around it

fish_generic.source: FAO FishStat Burkina Faso span across farmed species (catfish 1,250 to tilapia 2,250 XOF/kg official; field quotes to 3,000)

crop_lettuce.source: SOURCES DISAGREE ~3x, band widened to cover both: FAOSTAT PP Mali 2024 lettuce and chicory = 523 XOF/kg (2022-24: 376-523), a same-currency neighbour proxy since Burkina's own vegetable series stops in 2007; against ~165 XOF/kg derived from Niger producer data. Burkina sells lettuce by the planche (bed, 10,000-30,000 XOF) and by the head, and no source publishes bed area or head weight, so no direct per-kg price exists. Treat this line as the weakest in the book

crop_amaranth.source: Burkina Faso farm-gate for amaranth (a heat-tolerant local leafy green): 388 XOF/kg, range 300-750. Directly Burkinabe, unlike the lettuce proxy — but amaranth is not yet in crops.py, so this price has nothing to attach to until it is added

crop_leafy.source: FAOSTAT PP Mali 2024 leafy band: cabbages 372, lettuce 523, green onions 621 XOF/kg (Mali proxy for Burkina, see crop_lettuce)

crop_tomato.source: FAOSTAT PP, Mali 2024: tomatoes 494,024 XOF/tonne (2022-2024: 459-494). Mali proxy; Burkina's own tomato series ends 2007 at 80 XOF/kg

crop_okra.source: FAOSTAT PP, Mali 2022-2024: okra 466-548 XOF/kg (Mali proxy)

crop_fruiting.source: FAOSTAT PP Mali 2024 fruiting band: cucumbers 269, eggplant 300, tomato 494, okra 518 XOF/kg (Mali proxy)

tank_1000l.source: PE round tank NT$3,300-5,500 (lvneng.com.tw list/online, Shopee, findprice); used food-grade IBC totes NT$1,500-1,900 set the low end

gravel_m3.source: GSMMA national aggregate stats Jun 2026: crushed stone NT$359-372/tonne ex-plant, converted at 1.5-1.6 t/m3 (our conversion); ~NT$900/m3 delivered per Tainan-area quotes

biofilter_media_m3.source: Taiwan retail NT$200-210/kg (~5.5 L/kg => ~NT$36,000/m3, twaqua/Yahoo); Alibaba bulk US$280-300/m3 FOB (~NT$9,000-9,600) — buy bulk, add freight

raft_foam_m2.source: EPE foam board ~NT$270/m2; dedicated EPS hydroponic float boards NT$790-980/m2 (BigGo, Aug 2026)

liner_m2.source: BigGo pond-liner rolls NT$22-61/m2 by thickness; heavy PVC canvas ponds are custom-quoted

greenhouse_poly_m2.source: Simple steel-pipe + poly-film house NT$2,500-3,500/ping (PRO360 2026 cost guide; MOA portal quoting builder; farmer build ~NT$929/m2)

shade_net_m2.source: 60% shade net rolls, Yahoo listings — support structure NOT priced in this book; expect the structure to dominate the cost

fingerling_tilapia.source: YiHua hatchery (FB): 2 cm+ NT$4, 4 cm+ NT$6; 50-fish.com 6-7 cm NT$10 at 300+ pcs

feed_kg.source: Fwusow anchors: 23% CP tilapia pellet ~NT$32/kg, 43% CP ~NT$71-77/kg (Shopee, Aug 2026); a 32% CP grade falls between — midpoint is our interpolation, not a listing

electricity_kwh.source: Taipower tariff (taipower.com.tw): non-time-of-use tiers NT$1.78-8.86 summer / 1.78-7.03 non-summer; ~NT$3.78 average after Oct-2025 adjustment

water_m3.source: Taiwan Water Corporation tiers: NT$7.35 (<=10 m3/mo) to NT$12.075 (>50 m3/mo), plus meter base fee

fish_tilapia.source: Taiwan MOA farm-gate (池邊價) Jan-Feb 2026: NT$25/台斤 = NT$41.7/kg, against a stated production cost of NT$46.7-50/kg — Taiwanese tilapia farmers are currently selling BELOW COST. The high (76) is the 2024-25 Fisheries Yearbook level; pricing at that would overstate revenue by 60-80% today. FAO FishStat 2023 implied NT$64 sits between the two

fish_generic.source: Taiwan farmed finfish span: tilapia 42 (crisis level, Jan-Feb 2026), milkfish ~96, barramundi ~115 TWD/kg (FAO FishStat 2022 at 31.9 TWD/USD)

crop_lettuce.source: Taiwan MOA market data 2025-26: local round lettuce (本島萵苣) farm-gate NT$31.9/kg (Jan-May 2026) and wholesale NT$33.9; iceberg wholesale NT$26.4; HYDROPONIC lettuce (水耕) wholesale NT$62.8 — the hydroponic premium is real and is the relevant number for a soil-less system selling into that channel

crop_basil.source: Taiwan MOA wholesale, 九層塔 basil 2025-26: NT$38.1/kg annual, with a 3.2x SEASONAL SWING — NT$64/kg in January against NT$20 in August, driven by cold sensitivity field growers cannot engineer around. A protected system supplying Dec-Mar sells into the NT$50-64 window. No farm-gate series exists for basil

crop_tomato.source: Taiwan MOA: beef tomato (牛番茄) wholesale NT$49.8/kg 2025-26; farm-gate NT$56.2 (2025) and NT$28.0 (Jan-May 2026). Cherry tomato (玉女) farm-gate is far higher at NT$193.9/kg (2025) — variety choice dominates this line

crop_leafy.source: Taiwan MOA leafy band 2025-26, anchored on lettuce grades (see crop_lettuce)

crop_fruiting.source: Taiwan MOA fruiting band 2025-26: beef tomato 28-56, cherry tomato 194 TWD/kg — the range is variety, not noise
